taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Secret redaction at actual error/telemetry serialization boundaries
controls.source_trace: Follow a synthetic sensitive value through nested errors, URLs, headers and serializer fallbacks into the transmitted/retained event.
controls.implementation_branch: Find the actual serialization boundary for exception chains, structured attributes, attachments and fallback loggers. A redacted top-level message can coexist with a raw cause or breadcrumb. Use synthetic canaries with secret-like structure, confirm collector/export output and retain only the minimum redacted evidence; do not treat a regex match as proof of a real credential.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local telemetry stubs with synthetic fixtures in distinct field encodings; compare redacted expected fields and one nested/fallback path.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A redaction function existing in source is not proof it handles the emitted shape; an unrelated private tester log is not a target disclosure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Redact before transmission with structured field policy and verify normal debugging fields remain useful.
